columns.description: The number of columns, or `0` before the first layout.

measured.description: Whether the items have been measured and placed. Before that they render as a plain grid.

reflow.description: Measure and place the items again.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the masonry. Useful for composition.

columns.description:
The number of columns. Leave it unset to control it from CSS with the `--masonry-columns` variable, for example
to change it per breakpoint.

minColumnWidth.description:
The minimum column width, for example `"12rem"`. When set, the root fits as many columns as there is room for and
`columns` is ignored.

gap.description: The space between items, in pixels or as a CSS length. Leave it unset to control it from CSS with `gap`.

sequential.description: Whether items fill the columns in order, left to right, instead of going to the shortest column.

onLayoutChange.description: Function called when the number of columns or the height changes.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

index.description: The index of the shown item.

playing.description: Whether the items are flipping on their own.

next.description: Show the next item, wrapping around after the last one.

prev.description: Show the previous item, wrapping around before the first one.

goTo.description: Show the item at the given index.

getItemState.description: Returns whether an item is shown, flipping in, flipping out or hidden.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the text flip. Useful for composition.

interval.description: The time in milliseconds each item stays before the next one flips in.

autoplay.description: Whether the items start flipping on their own.

defaultIndex.description: The index of the item shown first.

onIndexChange.description: Function called when the shown item changes.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

rows.description: The rows to render. A looping wheel renders its items several times.

id.description: The unique id of the wheel picker.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the wheel picker. Useful for composition.

onValueChange.description: Function called when the selected value changes.

loop.description: Whether the items repeat, so the wheel never reaches an end.

itemHeight.description: The height of each row in pixels.

visibleCount.description: The number of rows in view. Keep it odd so one row sits in the middle.

disabled.description: Whether the wheel picker is disabled.

name.description: The name of the hidden input, for native forms.

form.description: The id of the form that owns the hidden input.

aria-label.description: The accessible label for the wheel picker.

aria-labelledby.description: The id of the element that labels the wheel picker.

enabled.description: Whether sourcery runs. The Next.js adapter turns it on for `next dev`, the others when `NODE_ENV` is `development`.

injectTo.description: Absolute path of the module the browser client is injected into, usually a root client component.

exclude.description: Path fragments to skip. `node_modules` is always skipped.

hotKeys.description: Keys held together to start inspecting.

editor.description: Editor to open: a known id (`code`, `cursor`, `zed`, `webstorm`, …), a command or a path. Detected when unset.

port.description: First port tried for the local open-in-editor server.

root.description: Directory source paths are recorded relative to.

ignoreTags.description: Extra element or component names to leave untagged, on top of `Fragment`, `Suspense`, `script`, `style`, `template` and `slot`.

panda.description:
Also record where Panda CSS `styled()`, `withProvider()`, `withContext()` and `withRootProvider()` components are
defined. Hold ⌥ with the hotkeys to open that definition. `modules` lists the import paths treated as Panda's `jsx`
entry, matched as suffixes.
